name: Second Lieutenant insignia, embroidered thread
size_basis: 1 in long per DAFI 36-2903 7.1.5.1 ("1-inch metal rank insignia"); width/gap read off CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-2 at that length (not dimensioned in either document)
estimated: Sizes other than the star diameter are not stated in inches by CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; proportions come from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-2.

mounts.rule: 2 in x 2 in dark blue square, center of chest. Generals: stars 1 in (3/4 in if unable), stacked vertically, one point up each; Colonel eagle centered horizontally, beak toward the wearer's right shoulder (viewer's left); Major / Lt Col stem toward the ground; Flight Officer / Lt / Capt bars with the long end vertical (7.1.1.2.1). Asset baseline = this orientation, rotation 0.

dark blue material on the front: generals positioned HORIZONTALLY with one point of each star up (use the -horizontal form); Colonel centered horizontally, beak toward the wearer's right shoulder; Major / Lt Col stem toward the ground; bars long end vertical (6.1.10.2.1, 6.1.14.4.1)

mounts.uniform: ABU / BDU / blue field coat collar
mounts.rule: light silver on dark blue cloth (2d Lt and Major gold), 1/8 in of blue showing past the widest and tallest point, centered 1 in from the bottom of the collar. Generals: stars centered, perpendicular to the collar (use the -horizontal form); Colonel centered, perpendicular to the collar, eagle facing forward; Lt Col / Major: stem parallel to the ground pointing AWAY from the wearer's neck = rotate the asset 90 degrees (+90 cw on the wearer's right collar so the stem points to the viewer's left, -90 on the left collar); Flight Officer / Lt / Capt: long end centered (5.1.1.1.1.1, 5.1.2.2.1, 5.2.1.1.1.1)

placement.note: +90 = clockwise on the wearer's right collar; mirror the rotation (-90) on the left collar; other grades 0

mounts.uniform: OCP / ABU / BDU / blue field / navy tactical cap (front)
mounts.rule: officers only (NCOs wear none, 7.1.1.8, 6.2.11.1): rank sewn or Velcro, centered 1/2 in from the visor (patrol/tactical OCP 7.1.1.8; ABU 5.1.1.2; blue field cap 5.2.1.1.1.2), only 1/8 in of blue showing past the widest and tallest point; silver on dark blue, 2d Lt and Major gold (6.2.11.1)

mounts.uniform: USAF-style flight duty uniform (FDU) / green flight jacket
mounts.rule: cloth-bordered form: dark blue cloth with silver or gold embroidery replaces the plastic-encased grade. Officers: centered on top of each shoulder, bottom edge of the insignia 1/2 in from the shoulder seam (8.2.3.2). Generals: 1 in stars (3/4 in optional) centered on the shoulder halfway between neck and shoulder seam (8.2.3.1). NCOs and cadets wear none (8.2.3.3).
plastic-encased or full-color grade embroidered on dark blue background, same placement as the FDU (8.3.3.2); NCOs and cadets: none (8.3.3.3)

mounts.uniform: Class A service coat (with epaulets), Class B blue shirt / blouse, corporate aviator shirt, jackets
mounts.rule: officers: embroidered grade on the slip-on gray epaulet sleeve, see rank-epaulet-sleeve-gray-*; Colonel eagle beak facing forward; Lt Col / Major stem points away from the collar; bars lie across the sleeve (4.1.5.2.1.1, 4.1.6.1.1-2, 4.1.1.1.1.3, 4.2.5.1.1.1-2)

anchor.single_forms: garment anchor rank_rule_point_left/right (Class B, mess) or rank_rule_point_left_center/right_center (Class A coat): 5/8 in from the outer end of the epaulet (DAFI 4.5.1.1.1); the slot container is 2.3 in along the strap and its centre sits about 0.6 in inboard of that point
anchor.multi_star_generals: garment rank_slot_*_center (Brig Gen single star at the rule point; Maj Gen pair stacked along the strap at the slot centre)

placement.when_placing_a_loose_piece_in_a_garment_: rotate so the Major / Lt Col stem points along the strap toward the arm end: rotate_deg = strap_angle_deg - 90 (strap angle measured from +x toward +y, about 14 deg on the Class A coat, 21 deg on the Class B shirt); bars lie across the strap: rotate_deg = strap_angle_deg; Colonel: regulation says only "beak facing forward" (4.1.6.1.2); the asset is drawn beak toward the viewer's left, keep it unrotated

mounts.rule: bullion grade on the board with 1/2 in dark blue braid down each side, as close to the shoulder seam as possible; Colonel beak forward; Lt Col / Major stem away from the collar (4.1.1.1.1.1-3, 4.1.2.1.1.1-3). Use rank-senior-<grade>-bullion (build-mess-dress-grade.js).
no epaulet sleeve; optional grade on the blazer nameplate for officers and NCOs, not for cadets (4.2.3.1.1.2, 4.2.4.1.1.2)
